Iran's nuclear program and regional influence draw international scrutiny

The United States has successfully pushed through a resolution at a UN watchdog body censuring Iran over its nuclear program, referring the matter to the UN Security Council. This action deepens the impasse regarding Iran's nuclear activities. Concurrently, reports indicate the Pentagon is exploring options concerning Iran's deepest nuclear sites. The coverage also highlights Iran's efforts to rebuild its proxy network across regions including Iraq and Yemen, positioning a small island off Yemen as a strategic prize in the widening Iran conflict.
